QF.id: AIF Valuation Taxation and Good Practices_69

answer.text: Continuously through CPE and by keeping abreast of the latest AIF, regulatory, fund and scheme developments

explanation.text: The Logic: The XIX-A workbook calls on distributors to stay abreast of the latest AIF industry, fund/manager/sponsor and scheme developments and separately describes NISM Continuing Professional Education (CPE) programs as the formal route for refreshing knowledge. The Trap: A one-time certification, no updates, or waiting for a SEBI directive all contradict the workbook expectation of continuous professional updating. Note: Industry events and self-study are not separately listed in the pages checked; the supported wording focuses on CPE plus keeping abreast of AIF, regulatory, fund and scheme developments.
